title: Tone Matters: The Impact of Linguistic Tone on Hallucination in VLMS

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses to images with missing or illegible information using a 5-Level Prompt Intensity Framework. The study measures how varying levels of linguistic pressure, constraint, and coercion in prompts cause vision-language models to abandon visual grounding and fabricate information to comply with the user (assessed via Attack Success Rate and Hallucination Severity Score).
